blocks.content: Time management and accuracy are the two most decisive factors in clearing Railway Recruitment Board examinations.

items: Exactly 1/3rd mark is deducted for each wrong answer in RRB CBT examinations.
General Science questions are heavily derived from NCERT Class 9 and 10 fundamentals.
Questions on Indian Railways zones, headquarters, and recent infrastructure developments are frequently asked.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: RRB exams primarily consist of Computer Based Tests assessing General Awareness, Mathematics, and General Intelligence & Reasoning.
A negative marking penalty of 1/3rd mark is applied for every incorrect response in RRB objective papers.
The General Awareness section places significant emphasis on current affairs, Indian Railways facts, and general science.
Consistent practice and speed are essential to navigate 100 to 120 questions within a strict 90-minute limit.
